versions.changelog:
Initial release of 游戏数值平衡校验 (ym-game-balance-calc).

- Provides command-line tool to check game damage formulas, level/exp curves, and economy systems.
- Offers reproducible balance reports with rerun commands for tweaking parameters and comparing results.
- Only three built-in formula types accepted (no custom expressions) for security and clarity.
- Outputs structured tables with verdicts on smoothness, bottlenecks, and breakpoints.
- No engine/game integration; only static calculations and assessment.
